qa_pairs.question: How do the baggage rules and schedules defined in metadata [0] and [1] relate to the categorization of goods subject to Customs Duty, and how do these legacy schedules define the scope of duty-liable items versus duty-free items as referenced in the AEO context provided in [2] and [3]?
qa_pairs.answer: According to [0] and [1], Schedule-2 (Tofshil-2) outlines goods subject to Customs Duty, including items not for personal/household use, baggage exceeding the allowed limit, and commercial quantities of goods. Conversely, as per [2] and [3], Schedule-3 (Tofshil-3) provides the list of items that are exempt from such duties and taxes, both schedules being applicable under the same rules (Rule 3(5), 3(7), and 10).
